entries.wording: 您的运单创建成功 准备发出
entries.note: The waybill is created; UNICON does not hold the parcel yet.

entries.wording: 系统已收到客户身份证信息
entries.note: UNICON has the recipient's identity card for Chinese customs, written beside the waybill's creation; the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before.
UNICON's first scan of the parcel, at its US consolidation warehouse.

entries.wording: 仓库已称重入库 SFO分拨中心
entries.note: Weighed in at the warehouse the row names, in the minute of the arrival above. Any warehouse.

entries.wording: 包裹已出库，准备送往机场
航班已起飞，包裹飞往中国

entries.note: The flight has landed in China and the parcel waits to be collected from the airline; clearance has not started.

entries.wording: 包裹正在中国海关清关中
包裹派送中，已转顺丰速运快递，快递单号为SF1669655531324
entries.note: The hand-off to the courier that delivers in China, with its name and number. Any courier and number.

entries.wording: 顺丰速运 已收取快件
entries.note: SF Express takes the parcel from UNICON, mid-journey for the parcel. SF's rows follow, opening with their city.

entries.wording: 快件在【古山村店】完成分拣，准备发往 【泉州晋江中转场】
entries.note: SF's depots fill the 【】, as in the rows below.

entries.wording: 快件在【泉州晋江中转场】完成分拣，准备发往 【北京顺航中转场】，根据规划班次预计发出时间【7月5日凌晨】
entries.note: The same sort with the departure SF plans, a day and part of it.

entries.wording: 快件到达 【北京顺航中转场】
快件正在派送途中（主单总件数：1件）
entries.note: SF's round, after the adapter takes out the courier it is handed to and their phone number.

entries.wording: 快件派送不成功(因电话无人接听/关机/无信号，暂无法联系到收方客户),正在处理中,待再次派送
entries.note: SF could not reach the recipient by phone and will try again.

entries.wording: 您的快件已签收，感谢您使用顺丰，期待再次为您服务。（主单总件数：1件）
entries.note: After the adapter takes out the line asking to call the courier, with their name and phone number.
